stage1_rice.title: 传统米坊里的淘米筛选.png

reasons: Rice sifting into the bag, the worker's hands and the sieve form one continuous work action; background equipment and grain state explain the process rather than reading as a static checklist.
Wood, bamboo sieve, metal machinery, woven sacks, plastic bucket and broom show differentiated material states rather than a single uniform aged finish.
Cropping of the worker, partial blur of machinery, sack occlusion and falling-grain trajectory contribute incidental documentary causality.
Residual risk remains: backlight/haze is somewhat photographic and traditional rice-workshop symbols are still relatively complete, but not enough to cross the FAIL threshold.
